properties.nt: Present-day Natural Earth outline of South Sudan (independent from 2011). Abyei, which Natural Earth lists as "Admin. by Sudan; Claimed by South Sudan", is shown as a separate disputed area and left out of this outline; the Ilemi Triangle, administered by Kenya, is not filled. Kafia Kingi, disputed between Sudan and South Sudan, has no licence-compatible boundary polygon, so it is not drawn as a separate area. Where it overlaps the outlines drawn for this era on this map, it is cut back to them. The South Sudan civil war (2013–2018), between forces loyal to Salva Kiir and to Riek Machar, is not drawn: there are no openly licensed, sourced front lines for it.
